findings.title: Cleanup removes supported facts when a line contains a CTA phrase
findings.trigger: A visible line says: Our office is open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM; call today for an appointment.
findings.design_impact: The entire hours line is discarded before persisted source evidence and AI extraction; replaying stored source cannot recover it.
findings.evidence: Executed isolated real exported extractor and source projection in /tmp/everycall-capture-audit-repro.mjs:9-16: no 8 AM text remains. Existing source-pages suite passes but lacks this mixed fact/CTA case.
findings.recommendation: Preserve factual spans and suppress only identified repeated boilerplate; retain recoverable original capture.

findings.title: Build lacks general deterministic conflict resolution and content-readiness QA
findings.trigger: Approved sources state different values for the same operational fact, such as office hours.
findings.design_impact: Consolidation keys include claim text, so different values remain separate. Validation samples existing artifacts for budgets/latency, not unresolved contradictions or missing topic/guardrail coverage.
findings.evidence: Read-only inspection of full compile orchestrator, consolidation, validation and downstream catalog safeguards; no model semantic simulation or full build executed. By-heart safety and tenant corrections were considered but do not provide general cross-source resolution.
findings.recommendation: Restore same-fact deterministic precedence/conflict quarantine and original content QA gates, or obtain explicit architectural disposition.

findings.title: Once-per-day build initiation guard is disabled
findings.trigger: A tenant initiates more than one fresh build in a day.
findings.design_impact: The frozen daily cap has no enforcement in the build allocator.
findings.evidence: Executed exact helper twice in isolated VM with throwing DB spy; both pass and query count remains zero. No decision removing limit found in reviewed later docs.
findings.recommendation: Restore atomic per-tenant daily enforcement and concurrent-call regression, or explicitly approve the requirement change.

findings.title: Nested relative links resolve against site origin
findings.trigger: A fetched /services/ page links to details or a relative downloadable filename.
findings.design_impact: Crawler asks for /details rather than /services/details, potentially omitting approved linked source evidence.
findings.evidence: Source caller passes crawlOrigin; isolated extractLinkInventory(origin, relative href) returns origin/details. No external crawl was performed.
findings.recommendation: Resolve nested links against the fetched page URL while preserving same-origin scope checks; add nested-relative page/file fixtures.

findings.title: Authority scoring favors unclassified uploads and drops negative content penalties
findings.trigger: An approved but unclassified upload competes with an operational website source; educational/marketing metadata is ranked.
findings.design_impact: Unclassified upload receives a 0.10 metadata boost versus website 0.02, contrary to confirmation/classification prerequisite. maxScore starts at zero, making educational/marketing negative penalties ineffective.
findings.evidence: Executed local compiled helper: website operational=0.02; unclassified uploaded operational=0.10; educational=0; marketing=0. This proves metadata scoring, not an end-to-end spoken answer.
findings.recommendation: Remove unclassified-source precedence advantage until classified and preserve negative class penalties; test same-fact and marketing-only support fixtures.

findings.title: Main compiler stores generic claims without semantic value normalization
findings.trigger: AI emits hours, booleans, service lists or other typed operational claims.
findings.design_impact: Main consolidation always writes generic source_compiled_fact/knowledge_support and null normalized_value_json; original structured normalization contract is only partly implemented.
findings.evidence: Read-only active compiler/caller tracing. Legacy typed deterministic helpers exist but are not used by compileKnowledgeBuildArtifacts.
findings.recommendation: Restore meaningful fact/object typing and normalized values or explicitly approve revised artifact semantics.
